tool_signatures.name: backfill_query_embeddings
tool_signatures.description: Backfill query_embedding column in retrieval_telemetry for rows that predate Phase 4a. Processes rows in batches. Set build_index=true to also create the HNSW index after backfill (runs CONCURRENTLY).

tool_signatures.name: cluster_results
tool_signatures.description: Groups search results by source_type (e.g. file extension, corpus, transcript). The cluster count is determined by the data, not by a parameter — see Issue #22 for why num_clusters/n_clusters were removed.

tool_signatures.name: deduplicate_results
tool_signatures.description: Remove duplicate search results based on text similarity

tool_signatures.name: get_hard_negatives
tool_signatures.description: Read hard negative (query, document) pairs from knowledge.hard_negative_pairs (issue #5). Filter by signal_type (explicit/behavioral/all), doc_id, or query_text_like. Returns pairs sorted by occurrence_count DESC.

tool_signatures.name: get_retrieval_telemetry
tool_signatures.description: Read retrieval telemetry rows (issue #5). Selector precedence: query_id > session_id > topic > recent. Returns newest-first.

tool_signatures.name: get_telemetry_stats
tool_signatures.description: Aggregate retrieval telemetry stats (issue #5): totals, feedback coverage, requery count, average score, oldest/newest timestamps. Optionally scoped by session_id and/or topic.

tool_signatures.name: investigation_add
tool_signatures.description: Add an investigation entry (open or append to an ops investigation)

tool_signatures.name: investigation_delete_experiment
tool_signatures.description: Hard-delete an investigation experiment by experiment_id (Issue #21). Requires confirm=True; in LORE_ENV=production also requires confirm_production=True.

tool_signatures.name: investigation_delete_note
tool_signatures.description: Hard-delete an investigation note by note_id (Issue #21). Requires confirm=True; in LORE_ENV=production also requires confirm_production=True.

tool_signatures.name: investigation_get
tool_signatures.description: Get a single investigation entry by ID

tool_signatures.name: investigation_list
tool_signatures.description: List investigations

tool_signatures.name: investigation_list_experiments
tool_signatures.description: List logged investigation experiments

tool_signatures.name: investigation_log_experiment
tool_signatures.description: Log a structured experiment within an investigation (hypothesis, methodology, results, conclusion)

tool_signatures.name: journal_append
tool_signatures.description: Append journal entry

tool_signatures.name: journal_delete
tool_signatures.description: Hard-delete a journal entry by entry_id (Issue #21). Requires confirm=True; in LORE_ENV=production also requires confirm_production=True.

tool_signatures.name: journal_get
tool_signatures.description: Get journal entry

tool_signatures.name: journal_list
tool_signatures.description: List journal entries

tool_signatures.name: journal_search
tool_signatures.description: Full-text search across journal entry content (Issue #15)

tool_signatures.name: kb_add
tool_signatures.description: Add a knowledge base entry

tool_signatures.name: kb_backfill_embeddings
tool_signatures.description: Embed any KB entries that are missing or stale (model/content changed). Idempotent: skips entries whose stored content_hash still matches. Requires LORE_SEMANTIC_SEARCH=true.

tool_signatures.name: kb_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete existing KB entry from database

tool_signatures.name: kb_embedding_status
tool_signatures.description: Report embedding coverage: total entries, embedded count, missing count, current model, and per-model breakdown.

tool_signatures.name: kb_get
tool_signatures.description: Get full KB entry by ID

tool_signatures.name: kb_get_batch
tool_signatures.description: Fetch full content for multiple KB entries by ID. Use after kb_search to retrieve content without N+1 round trips.

tool_signatures.name: kb_ingest_dir
tool_signatures.description: Batch ingest directory of markdown files

tool_signatures.name: kb_ingest_doc
tool_signatures.description: Ingest single markdown file into KB with change detection

tool_signatures.name: kb_list
tool_signatures.description: List KB entries

tool_signatures.name: kb_search
tool_signatures.description: Search knowledge base. Lexical FTS5 (or LIKE fallback) by default; set semantic=true / hybrid=true / search_mode=hybrid to use vector embeddings + RRF fusion (requires LORE_SEMANTIC_SEARCH=true).

tool_signatures.name: kb_sync_status
tool_signatures.description: Check sync state between source docs and KB

tool_signatures.name: kb_update
tool_signatures.description: Update existing KB entry content, title, topic, tags, verified state, and trust_score

tool_signatures.name: log_retrieval_feedback
tool_signatures.description: Score or annotate a prior kb_search result by its query_id (retrieval telemetry, issue #5). Supply user_feedback_score, required_requery, notes, or any combination; an omitted field is left unchanged (cannot be reset to null). No effect unless LORE_HARD_NEGATIVE_MINING=true on a PostgreSQL backend.

tool_signatures.name: mcp_index_get_server
tool_signatures.description: Get all tools for a specific MCP server

tool_signatures.name: mcp_index_get_tool
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific tool

tool_signatures.name: mcp_index_rebuild
tool_signatures.description: Force rebuild of entire MCP index (same as mcp_index_scan)

tool_signatures.name: mcp_index_scan
tool_signatures.description: Scan all MCP servers and index their tools. By default, scans only configured servers (66% token savings).

tool_signatures.name: mcp_index_search
tool_signatures.description: Search for MCP tools by description/capability

tool_signatures.name: multi_search
tool_signatures.description: Search across all configured sources simultaneously (KB, local files, transcripts, corpora) with a single query. Returns combined results from all available sources. For searching within a specific source only, use kb_search, search_local, search_transcripts, or search_corpora instead.

tool_signatures.name: refresh_hard_negatives
tool_signatures.description: Scan retrieval_telemetry for low-scored and requery signals, then upsert hard negative (query, document) pairs into knowledge.hard_negative_pairs (issue #5). Use since= (ISO timestamp) for an incremental refresh; dry_run=true returns counts without writing. Requires LORE_HARD_NEGATIVE_MINING=true on a PostgreSQL backend.

tool_signatures.name: search_corpora
tool_signatures.description: Search across corpus manifests (JSONL files)

tool_signatures.name: search_local
tool_signatures.description: Search local files by content (lexical mode)

tool_signatures.name: search_transcripts
tool_signatures.description: Search transcript segments from Whisper outputs

tool_signatures.name: snapshot_config
tool_signatures.description: Snapshot current config
